annotations.title: Was I overcharged? Check a fare that was paid

description: Fair Fare. Was I overcharged? Check a fare that was paid. Compares what was paid with the official meter tariff, the airport flat fare or New York's typical Uber and Lyft prices for the same trip and hour, gives a verdict (fair, high or overcharged), the next steps for that company or city regulator, and a short message to send asking for a refund.

city.description: Tariff city id, when giving miles instead of from and to.

kind.description: Kind: taxi, uber, lyft, bolt or minicab. Defaults to taxi.

miles.description: Trip length in miles, instead of from and to.

minutes.description: Trip time in minutes, if known.

paid.description: What was paid, without the tip, for example 48.50.

when.description: When the trip starts, in local time: now (the default), a time like 18:30 or 6pm, or a date and time like 2026-10-09T18:30.
